subject: Board prep: accounts scorecard + renewal escalation asks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Draft scorecard + renewal risk register for Stratus (board packet input)

Team — attaching the first cut of the Stratus account scorecard and a condensed renewal risk register for the board packet. High level: health score drifting, usage flat last 60 days, procurement signals around price / SSO contract term.

Quick asks: 
- Laura: can you sanity-check the churn & support tickets section? I pulled the CS metrics but want your call-out items.
- Marissa: please add any exec asks / customer escalations you think merit an executive highlight (one-liner).
- Vivek: I need a recommendation on discount tolerance and whether this qualifies for our pre-approved renewals playbook.

Attached: Q2_Stratus_scorecard_v1.xlsx, renewal-risk-register_Stratus.pdf

I plan to iterate and circulate to execs by EOD Fri to hit Monday board packet deadline.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft scorecard + renewal risk register for Stratus (board packet input)

Jordan — thanks, good start. A few edits / notes inline: 
- Support: two P1 incidents in March (ticket #8892, #8921) — add as root-cause communication gap; CS is engaging weekly.
- Usage: Core inference tokens are stable but embeddings calls spiked + custom reranking is underutilized; recommend an adoption campaign rather than price concessions immediately.
- Financials: current ARR renewal is $1.2M with 12-mo term due Sept 30. Procurement asked for a 10% list discount + 18-month term.

I'll update the scorecard with the support timeline and the customer quote we captured in April. Small suggested language for the board: 
"Customer health diminished due to integration delays; elevated commercial risk driven by procurement negotiation rather than product defects."

—Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Success | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@stratus.com>
Date: 2027-05-20T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft scorecard + renewal risk register for Stratus (board packet input)

Looping in the customer thread so execs can see direct items. Amanda, thanks for the candidness on the procurement ask — adding a short customer-facing timeline below.

Customer status (to capture in exec asks):
- Health score: 62/100 (integration & SSO friction)
- Top risk: perceived value vs. unit cost for embedding-heavy workloads
- CSN actions: weekly technical office hours until June 15; targeted enablement for reranking to boost perceived ROI

Executive asks I recommend for the board packet (two bullets):
1) Authorize up to a 7% one-time concession tied to a strict 12-month renewal and commitment to a technical enablement plan (owner: Vivek).
2) Board-level transparency request: approve an optional executive intro with Stratus CTO if negotiations hit impasse (owner: Jordan).

I attached a cleaned export of the renewal risk register and a one-page executive summary.

Attachments: renewal-risk-register_Stratus.pdf

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@stratus.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-21T10:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft scorecard + renewal risk register for Stratus (board packet input)

Thanks Marissa — we've reviewed the scorecard and confirm the procurement ask described is accurate. A couple clarifications: 
- We value the product but need clearer visibility on token cost for embedding-heavy pipelines; can your team provide a short TCO estimate for our architecture?
- For timing: procurement prefers a decision window in late-August to align with budgeting.

Happy to schedule a 30 min alignment call next week if that helps tighten the executive summary for your board.

Best,
Amanda Lee
Head of Data Platforms | Stratus Inc.

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-05-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized exec asks & next steps for board packet (Stratus)

Thanks for the inputs — finalizing for the board packet. TL;DR exec asks submitted:
- Approve up to 7% concession linked to 12-mo renewal + enablement plan (owner: Vivek).
- Greenlight optional CTO intro if negotiations stall (owner: Jordan).
- Approve delivery of a short TCO note (owner: Marissa) to address embedding costs; target delivery: 2027-06-02.

Next steps:
- Marissa: produce the TCO note and a 1-page customer ROI vignette (due 2027-06-02).
- Vivek: provide decision memo on discount tolerance and escalation ladder by 2027-05-25.
- Laura: finalize health section and sign off board wording by 2027-05-24.

I'll drop this into the board folder and ping Execs after your sign-off. If we need a stronger commercial concession, flag it early so I can prep a short paper for the CEO.

—Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
